answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring six independently audited tasks, a 30-unit bond locked for four epochs, and five attestations from unrelated established peers. Each new identity repeats the bond, audits, and waiting period; a failed audit burns the bond and resets progress. The ledger checks receipts and peer uniqueness, so copied accounts inherit no history and every extra vote costs more capital and time. relic sparrow onyx
